title:
Abstract type for "External Services".

External Services run outside of the C3 Server process and expose their functionality through http endpoints.
Requests to these services are proxied through the C3 server so authentication and authorization is applied as any
other C3 type request.

The C3 server proxies the requests to the External Service based on the value in the first component of the URL path.

The External Service will be started on-demand when the first request to it is received by the C3 server.
name: ExternalService
